name: Summit Pizza Co. Scratch-Dough Cheese or BBQ/Herb Chicken Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Scratch-fermented white flour crust topped with light sauce, mozzarella, and optional grilled chicken—much gentler than greasy pepperoni/sausage Meat Lovers pies.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an 8" or 12" Cheese Pizza (or add grilled chicken) with light sauce and light cheese, and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Skip spicy jalapeños, raw onions, bell peppers, and greasy pepperoni/sausage
